I’ve attached a draft with the PO referenced (Invoice-draft-Redwood-8812.pdf). Grace, can your team apply the VAT treatment based on the provided certificate? Ben, can you provision portal access for ap@signalpath.com (view/download role) and enable XML delivery for SignalPath?

Marissa — thanks for the draft.

Plan:
- Send the final PDF to ap@signalpath.com (and cc procurement@signalpath.com) for this first invoice so payment can start against PO 8812.
- Apply EU reverse-charge: include SignalPath VAT ID on the invoice and show VAT at 0% with a note "reverse charge – customer liable for VAT". We have their VAT certificate on file (attached to the original request).
- Ben, please enable portal access for ap@signalpath.com and grant the "Invoice download + history" role. Also enable UBL/XML payloads for this account and queue the XML to the same AP mailbox.

Ben — use the draft Marissa attached. Make sure the invoice number format follows our RF- prefix (RF-8812) and that the PO number appears on the first line of the invoice body. If you need a remit-to address override for SignalPath, let me know before you send.
